## History

Bipartite, parts of size 9 and 11, 66 edges. This one IS genuinely K\_(3,4)-free: no 3 vertices on either side share 4 common neighbours (verified in both orientations). The only one of the three Zarankiewicz witnesses for which the abstract "K\_(3,4)-free" description is true.
